bull_case_summary: CelcomDigi has observed integration savings, fibre growth and modest H1 service-revenue/EBIT resilience. Round two distinguishes these H1 measures from adverse quarterly PAT and leaves group conversion and financing as conditions for recovery.
bear_case_summary: Q2 PAT fell as quarterly EBIT and financing worsened, while prepaid revenue declined. Round two accepts period-specific resilience but stresses that savings and fibre growth have not demonstrated a group earnings turnaround or funding relief.
key_points_of_agreement: Savings and fibre growth are observed operating levers.
H1 resilience and weaker Q2 earnings can coexist.
Segment growth is not proof of incremental group profit.
Oversold RSI provides no recovery confirmation.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether modest H1 resilience makes the conditional savings-led recovery materially stronger despite latest-quarter pressure.
unresolved_uncertainties: Incremental and recurring group-profit contribution of savings and fibre.
Financing costs, debt maturities and cash conversion.
Prepaid stabilisation and matched valuation for recovery risk.
